class.name: com.simplysoftware.jSerialEnhanced.jSerialEnhanced
class.comment: Enhanced Serial library for B4J using the jSerialComm backend.

method.name: Write
method.comment: Queues a byte array for transmission. If loopback is enabled, data is injected locally.

method.name: PurgeRX
method.comment: Clears internal RX buffer and attempts hardware RX purge.

method.name: IsCTS
method.comment: Returns true if the CTS line is asserted.

method.name: SendBreak
method.comment: Sends a break signal for the specified duration in milliseconds.

method.name: SetFlowControl
method.comment: Sets the hardware flow control mode. mode: one of the SerialPort.FLOW_CONTROL_* constants.

method.name: GetStats
method.comment: Returns a Map containing current statistics.

method.name: ReadUntil
method.comment: Read until the terminator byte is seen or timeout expires. Returns the bytes up to and including the terminator, or null on timeout. timeoutMs = 0 means non-blocking (single check).

method.name: GetPortInfo
method.comment: Returns a Map containing detailed hardware and USB information for the port.

method.name: Initialize
method.comment: Initialises the object and sets the event prefix. EventName: the event name prefix for callbacks.

method.name: EncodeBase64FromString
method.comment: Encodes a standard Java String into a Base64 text representation. text is the plain text String to encode. Must not be null. Return a Base64‑encoded String representing the original text.

method.name: ReadExact
method.comment: Read exactly 'count' bytes or null on timeout. timeoutMs = 0 means non-blocking (single check).

method.name: Open
method.comment: Opens the specified serial port with the given parameters. Returns true on success, false on failure.

method.name: GetOpenPortName
method.comment: Returns the system name of the currently open port. Returns an empty string if no port is open.

method.name: ListPorts
method.comment: Returns a B4X List of available system COM port names. The list is sorted in a human-friendly order.

method.name: SetParameters
method.comment: Applies new serial parameters to the open port and raises the PortReconfigured event if the port is active. baud specifies the baud rate. dataBits specifies the number of data bits. stopBits specifies the number of stop bits. parity specifies the parity mode (0–4).

method.name: ClearInternalBuffer
method.comment: Clears the internalBuffer contents.

method.name: PurgeTX
method.comment: Clears TX queue and attempts hardware TX purge.

method.name: BytesToHex
method.comment: Converts a byte array to a space‑separated hexadecimal string. data is the byte array to convert. Return a formatted hexadecimal string, or an empty string if the array is null or empty.

method.name: IsDCD
method.comment: Returns true if the DCD line is asserted.

method.name: IsDSR
method.comment: Returns true if the DSR line is asserted.

method.name: IsRI
method.comment: Returns true if the RI line is asserted.

method.name: GetDeviceType
method.comment: Returns a short chipset identifier based on the port's VID.

method.name: ReadWithTimeout
method.comment: Reads until at least minBytes are available or timeout expires. Returns whatever bytes are available.

method.name: ReadAvailable
method.comment: Returns a snapshot of currently available bytes in internalBuffer without consuming them.

method.name: PurgeAll
method.comment: Clears internal buffers and attempts hardware purge if supported.

method.name: IsPortBusy
method.comment: Returns true if the specified port appears to be busy. Returns false if it can be opened or is already open by this instance.

method.name: HexToBytes
method.comment: Converts a hexadecimal string to a byte array. Non‑hex characters are ignored. The string must contain an even number of hex digits. hex is the hexadecimal string to convert. Return a byte array containing the converted values.

method.name: SetAccumulationDelay
method.comment: Sets the accumulation delay used to reduce fragmentation. ms: delay in milliseconds.

method.name: Close
method.comment: Closes the port and performs full cleanup. Triggers PortDisconnected and Closed events.

property.name: SetDTR
property.comment: Returns the last known DTR state.

field.name: EnableLowLatency
field.comment: Requests low‑latency read behaviour. EnableLowLatency reduces driver timeouts where supported.

field.name: EnableLoopbackSimulation
field.comment: Enables software loopback simulation. EnableLoopbackSimulation returns written data as incoming data.

field.name: SetDebugLogging
field.comment: Enables diagnostic logging. SetDebugLogging writes internal debug messages to the log.

field.name: AggregationMaxTotalMs
field.comment: Safety cap (ms) for total aggregation time to avoid waiting indefinitely while coalescing a burst. Only raise this for very slow, long bursts. Default: 500

field.name: AggregationPollMs
field.comment: Poll interval (ms) used while aggregating incoming bytes. Lower values reduce aggregation latency; higher values reduce CPU wakeups. Default: 5

field.name: AggregationIdleWindowMs
field.comment: Idle window (ms) after the last received byte before emitting one aggregated _NewData event. Increase to capture microbursts; decrease for lower latency. Default: 20
